_experimental: #558 material candidate; documentation fixture only, not runtime schema

normalizationExpectations.height: Compile static height to geometry/cache; do not require it as a per-frame shader sampler once geometry is resolved.
normalizationExpectations.staticMasks: May be channel-packed or atlased in a runtime cache if measurement justifies it; authored files remain separate and named.
normalizationExpectations.animatedProperties: Only the property that animates requires frame resources. Static height/albedo/emission are not duplicated to match another property's frame count.
normalizationExpectations.passSlots: Renderer may impose a fixed pass-slot bound after validation; the authored asset model is not defined by that bound.
normalizationExpectations.provenance: Renderable/export diagnostics should retain links from normalized material inputs back to their semantic source images.

explicitNonGoal: No animated height in this ordinary material fixture. Animated geometry is a separate experiment because current height participates in CPU mesh compilation.
